summary: Commit units, red proofs, documentation exemptions, the CI suite and the five-harness render hold, but the step 9 lookup, retry, non-blocking assignment and resume rules have no asserting test, and the text-contract checker accepts reversed-meaning text.

findings.summary: Behaviour added to step 9 (failed lookup halts and never creates, one bounded creation retry, no URL recorded on halt, non-blocking assignment check, resume without a duplicate PR) has no asserting test.
findings.evidence: ENG-1. Rules at SKILL.md:159, :161, :163 and state.md:216 are asserted by no test. pr_contract_gaps (tools/tests/test_pr_publication.py:28) returned [] on copies where each rule was reversed: lookup failure continues and creates anyway; retry creation until it succeeds; record the URL on any halt; a mismatch halts the run; resume skips the lookup. The declared failure paths in plan.md 'Test seams' cover only six marker removals.
findings.fix: Through the orchestrator (ENG-4; engineering.md 'Confirmed test scope'), declare these clauses as failure paths in plan.md 'Test seams' and obtain fresh scope confirmation. Then add injected copies that reverse each clause (lookup-failure-creates, unbounded-retry, url-on-halt, assignment-halts, resume-skips-lookup), each asserting exactly one new element name, and add those elements to contracts/pr-publication.md's element table.

findings.summary: The existing text-contract elements check literal presence, so resume-rule and lookup-after-error still pass when the rule they name is reversed.
findings.evidence: ENG-18. Line 54 accepts any line containing 'step 9' and 'Branch PR lookup' without 'gh pr view'; line 42 accepts any section line containing the four literals whatever it instructs. Reproduced on mutated copies.
findings.fix: Tighten the two element checks to assert the rule's clauses, updating the contract element table; keep element names and order.

findings.summary: Core step 9 omits DESIGN.md's rule that an assignment problem is never persisted.
findings.evidence: Constitution Principle I; DESIGN.md:233 says 'never persisted (no state field, issue kind or history event)'; SKILL.md items 4 and 8 state no such prohibition.
findings.fix: Add to step 9 item 4: 'Nothing is persisted for an assignment problem: no state field, issue kind or history event.'

findings.evidence: ENG-7. CONTEXT.md '## Language' has no 'Branch PR' entry.
findings.fix: Add a glossary entry or reword the uses to an existing term.
